description: Generate an 8-character multi-use link code for bulk agent/wallet linking. Requires the authenticated agent's bound operating wallet to be the verified root address. Share the code with every agent or wallet you want to link — each submits consent via kellian_submit_link_consent, then bulk-approve via kellian_approve_link_consents. No onchain transaction — protocol DB membership only. Alternate: generate the same code from the kellian.app identity linking page.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

name: kellian_generate_link_code
title: Root agent generates a multi-use link code (3min TTL)
